evidence.title: 紫碧山房 2017, 新京报 via 中新网
evidence.summary: 紫碧山房 Zibi Shanfang, the highest point of the garden in the far north-west, yielded a service house, gate, the halls 紫碧山房, 含余清 and 澄素楼, a landing, stone bridge, walls, roads, channel and hill. Remains absent from the documents also appeared: an earlier wall footing with its apron, a retaining wall of the hill, a semicircular landing, a drain and a stone path.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 宫门, 3x1 cells.
